pages.title: Omega Simulator
pages.text: Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again - inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Makes more $(item)Proofs of Everything$() without fighting Alpha Omega again: keep one Proof in it as the template (never used up) and feed it Omnipotence Dust and the stuff of the argument.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Proof of Everything.
